kwame.text: Hello? Yes. Odin Krohotel, Kwame speaking. How can I help you today? Good morning, Odin Krohotel. This is Kwame. A Kwaba. Welcome to Odin Krohotel. What can I do for you? Ah, let me check that for you. Yes, we have the executive suite available for those dates. That's $200 per night. Breakfast is included. Our standard room is $80. Deluxe is 120. Check in is at 2 in the afternoon. Check out is 11 in the morning. Would you like ocean view or city view? How many guests will be staying with us? Shall I hold the booking for you? I'll need your full name, phone number and email address. Let me repeat that back. Executive suite, March 15 to 18 to 2 guests. Your booking is confirmed. You'll get a confirmation email shortly. Is there anything else I can help with? I'm really sorry about that. That's not the experience we want for you. Let me connect you with my manager right away. We have a swimming pool, restaurant, free Wi-Fi and airport shuttle. Breakfast is served from 630 to 10 every morning. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. We accept visa, mastercard, mobile money and cash. A deposit equal to the first night is required. The airport is 30 minutes away. Shuttle is $25. You're most welcome. Safe travels and we'll see you soon. Thank you for calling a dinkro hotel. Enjoy the rest of your day.

amina.text: Hello, this is Amina. How can I help you today? Good morning, Amina speaking. What can I do for you? Karibu, welcome to Sinea Bank. How may I assist you? Let me check your account. Yes, I can see your balance. Your current balance is 15,000 shillings. Your last transaction was yesterday. A payment of 2,000 shillings. Would you like me to help with that transfer? I'll need your account number and phone number to verify. Let me repeat that. Account number one, two, three, four, five, six. Is that correct? Your payment has been processed. You'll get an SMS confirmation. Is there anything else I can help with today? I'm sorry to hear about that. Let me look into it. I understand your frustration. Let me fix this right away. Your card has been blocked for security. A new one will arrive in five days. We can reverse that transaction. It will take up to 24 hours and pays payments usually reflect within a few minutes. Sawa, Sawa, no problem at all. Paul for the inconvenience. Let me make it right. I'll transfer you to the dispute steam now. Thank you for calling. Asante Sana, have a good day.

kofi.text: Aquaba. This is Kofi at a Sassy Restaurant, ready to take your order? Hello Sassy Restaurant, Kofi speaking. What can I get for you? Good evening! Kofi here. Are we doing dinin'? Take away? Or delivery? Ha ha, great choice. Joll off with chicken medium spice. Would you like Khelewell with that? It's fresh today. Our specials today are Banco with Talapea and Groundnut Soup. Let me repeat your order. Wall off rice with chicken, medium spice, extra Khelewell, that comes to 53 CDs. How would you like to pay? We accept mobile money, cash on delivery, and card payment. Your order number is 47. It'll be ready in 25 minutes. Delivery to that area takes about 30 minutes. Is that okay? Sorry, we're out of wacky A today. Can I suggest Joll off instead? Any allergies I should know about? We use ground nuts and some dishes. Would you like a drink? So Bolo is very fresh today. Your food is on the way. The writer will call when nearby. Thank you for choosing a Sassy Restaurant. Enjoy your meal. We have a special on fried rice this week. Two for 30 CDs. Let me check with the kitchen. One moment please. Sawa, Sawa. I've added extra pepper for you. Thank you for calling. Medase, come again soon.

maya.text: Hello! This is Maya from Sinia Scheduling. How can I help you today? Good morning. Maya speaking. What appointment would you like to book? I can help you schedule a booking. What date works best for you? Let me check availability. One moment please. Yes, we have slots available on Tuesday at 10 in the morning. Would you prefer morning or afternoon? I can book you for Thursday at 2 in the afternoon. Does that work? Let me repeat that. Tuesday, March 15th, 10 in the morning, correct? Your appointment is confirmed. You'll get an SMS reminder. Would you like to reschedule? I can help with that. I'm sorry, that time is fully booked. How about 1130? The doctor is available on Friday, morning or afternoon. Your booking reference is c-y-n-4-7-2. Note that down. A reminder will be sent one day before your appointment. Is there anything else I can help you schedule? I understand. Let me find an earlier slot for you. Sawa, Sawa. Your booking is all set. Thank you for choosing Sinia. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye and see you on Tuesday.
